LCC Studio

3DGS processing engine that transforms scan data into photorealistic models in universal \(.ply\) or proprietary \(.lcc\) formats with 90% smaller file sizes, supporting both offline viewing and web publishing.

Windows V2.6.1
Desktop
File Size5.8 GB

Release Notes
- \- Fixed an issue where rebuild tasks failed with an "Undefined error" when the output directory or project path contained Chinese or Japanese characters.
Important

\- As of v1.9.0, Lixel L2 device data is no longer supported for reconstruction; use v1.8.1 or older.

|---|---|

|---|---|
